name: gali
description: GALI monorepo root. Frontend is in packages/web. Python packages (core/api/pipeline) are managed separately via pip, see .venv.

scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/web run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('packages/web/.next', '.next', {recursive: true}); if (fs.existsSync('packages/web/public')) fs.cpSync('packages/web/public', 'public', {recursive: true});"
scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix packages/web run build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('packages/web/.next', '.next', {recursive: true}); if (fs.existsSync('packages/web/public')) fs.cpSync('packages/web/public', 'public', {recursive: true});"
